positions.name: AsyncRememberContractGuarantees
positions.frame: what does the ratified async job contract for remember commit to, and how is that commitment operationally satisfied — from dispatch through receipt to resolution?
positions.why: All three expressions trace the same ratified contract from a single directional angle — first the act of settling it, then the invariants it locks in (no blocking, no lost work), then the concrete dispatch/poll/piggyback mechanism that makes those invariants true in practice. The dimensional reads show a conviction gradient across the set (src-1 performs a decision, src-2 states bedrock principle, src-3 offers a plain descriptive claim) and a stable register (native pipeline jargon delivered flat, unhedged, throughout) — the gradient is held as internal texture of one settled contract being described at three levels of resolution, not a reason to split the group.
